default_sigma.name: ESPEI experimental reference sigma_HM = 500 J/mol (used only to convert the calibrated DFT sigma into an ESPEI weight)

orchid_uncertainty.weight_rule: weight per value = 500 J/mol / calibrated sigma_DFT (leave-system-out robust sigma of the value's stratum; bias recorded, not applied)
orchid_uncertainty.sigma_rule: sigma_effective = max(sqrt(max(printed, reading, method)^2 + composition^2 + conversion^2), scatter) (literature release `uncertainty_budget`; components kept per value in `budget`); DFT: sigma_method = calibrated sigma_DFT, no printed sigma

values.weight_meaning: ESPEI's experimental reference sigma_HM (500 J/mol) / calibrated DFT sigma: the conversion that makes ESPEI use the calibrated sigma; 500 J/mol is not a DFT uncertainty

budget.method_basis: calibrated (leave-system-out robust sigma of DFT - experiment)
